newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 400 MW peak firm power for Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 400 MW peak firm power for Monday.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 400 MW of peak firm power for Monday preschedulings, up from 200 MW for today, but prices were unchanged, the agency said Friday.
BPA offered the peak firm power at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $20.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA also offered 400 MW of peak firm power for Saturday at $16.00 (Northwest) and $18.00 (COB) per MWh and 200 MW of off-peak firm at $13.00 for all deliveries.
Surplus power was offered during all hours on Sunday at prices ranging from $13.00 for off-peak firm to $17.00 for on-peak non-firm.
